coverage_gaps: No non-FDA regulators are available, limiting direct comparison with EMA and other jurisdictional actions.
No dedicated citation-graph or DOI metadata route is available; backward and forward citation expansion must be approximated through PubMed linked records and explicit identifiers.
No preprint route is available, so unpublished or not-yet-indexed analyses cannot be systematically assessed.
ClinicalTrials.gov may not expose every historical version through a simple query interface; full change-history verification may require separately preserved registry snapshots.
FDA web search and archived label discovery may be incomplete without a versioned regulatory archive, so effective dates and superseded wording require document-level verification.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence first made public after 2024-12-31, except later integrity notices used solely to flag that the historical evidence status may require reassessment.
Studies limited to diseases other than rheumatoid arthritis unless they directly support an FDA regulatory action applying to marketed tofacitinib and are labeled indirect.
Preclinical, animal, in vitro, efficacy-only, pharmacokinetic-only, and mechanistic records without decision-relevant clinical safety outcomes.
Narrative commentary lacking new data or a specific methodological critique, retained only as a route to primary evidence.
Duplicate reports after identifier-level merging; all query-to-record links and distinct versions remain preserved.
Unadjusted spontaneous-report disproportionality interpreted as comparative incidence or causal risk.
Records that mention JAK inhibitors as a class without separable tofacitinib evidence or direct relevance to an FDA action affecting tofacitinib.
Retracted evidence used as valid support; such records remain in an integrity ledger with retraction status and affected claims.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence available on or before 2024-12-31; distinguish publication, online-first, registry-posting, and regulatory effective dates.

Adult rheumatoid arthritis populations exposed to marketed tofacitinib, with mixed-disease evidence included only when rheumatoid arthritis results are separable or directly inform an FDA class action affecting tofacitinib.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its results history, protocol identifiers, primary publication, linked secondary analyses, and FDA actions based on the study.
Comparative or noncomparative evidence reporting cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, all-cause mortality, or cardiovascular mortality.
Primary trials, registry results, FDA source documents, systematic reviews used for discovery, and sufficiently adjusted observational studies used as qualifying or conflicting evidence.
Correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, or retraction notices linked by PMID, DOI, title, author, registry identifier, or explicit citation.
Records linkable across sources by NCT number, protocol number, PMID, DOI, exact title, sponsor, intervention arms, or concordant study dates.
Both positive and null or conflicting findings, with dose, comparator, follow-up, estimand, and population-risk differences preserved.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and capture sponsor protocol identifiers, population, interventions, comparators, prespecified outcomes, enrollment, dates, results postings, and linked publications.
Recover the primary publication and establish identifier linkage to the registry.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover FDA material explicitly tied to the required postmarketing safety trial.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 FDA

queries.purpose: Retrieve broad peer-reviewed safety evidence in rheumatoid arthritis without a restrictive study-design filter.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR CP-690550[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify registered rheumatoid arthritis studies that report relevant safety outcomes and detect related or predecessor trials.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch](Rheumatoid Arthritis) AND AREA[InterventionSearch](tofacitinib)

queries.purpose: Find the chronology of FDA safety communications, boxed-warning revisions, use restrictions, and supporting reviews.
queries.query: site:fda.gov/drugs tofacitinib Xeljanz safety communication boxed warning thrombosis cancer cardiovascular death

queries.purpose: Confirm the coprimary cardiovascular and malignancy findings, estimands, hazard ratios, confidence intervals, and noninferiority interpretation.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis and mortality findings, including dose-specific results and event definitions.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recheck the completed registry record, posted results, outcome timing, adverse-event tables, amendments, and publication links against the primary report.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId](NCT02092467) AND AREA[OverallStatus](Completed)

queries.purpose: Locate the definitive FDA class-warning action and document its date, affected outcomes, indicated population, and prescribing restrictions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov "FDA requires warnings about increased risk" "JAK inhibitors" tofacitinib

queries.purpose: Recover dated prescribing-information versions and verify the exact marketed-label consequences of the safety findings.
queries.query: site:accessdata.fda.gov Xeljanz label tofacitinib boxed warning cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality

queries.purpose: Retrieve linked analyses that qualify absolute or relative risk by age, smoking, baseline cardiovascular risk, geography, dose, and treatment exposure.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR post-hoc[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor*[Title/Abstract] OR age[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find external observational evidence that may corroborate, narrow, or conflict with ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR real-world[Title/Abstract] OR "STAR-RA"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Detect correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, and retraction records that could alter evidence handling.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]))) AND (correction[Publication Type] OR retracted publication[Publication Type] OR retraction of publication[Publication Type] OR erratum[Title] OR retract*[Title/Abstract] OR "expression of concern"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek methodological critiques, conflicting findings, null evidence, and limitations relevant to causal and generalizability judgments.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (critique[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract] OR confound*[Title/Abstract] OR contradictory[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Compare the full change history and posted outcomes with publications to identify discrepancies, delayed reporting, or amended definitions.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId](NCT02092467)

queries.purpose: Check whether FDA corrected, superseded, or withdrew relevant safety communications or regulatory conclusions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib correction recall withdrawal retraction safety communication

queries.purpose: Capture later analyses, replication evidence, and integrity notices through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract])) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Publication Type] OR retracted publication[Publication Type])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify registry changes posted after the primary publication through the as-of date.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId](NCT02092467) AND AREA[LastUpdatePostDate]RANGE[01/01/2022, 12/31/2024]

queries.purpose: Capture FDA updates, label revisions, and safety communications issued through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality after:2021-12-31 before:2025-01-01

question_frame: Safety/PECO frame: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis, especially patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, assess marketed tofacitinib versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other active comparators through 2024-12-31 for major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality. Link the pivotal postauthorization ORAL Surveillance study across ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT02092467, its primary peer-reviewed publication, FDA requirements, communications, labeling actions, and subsequent qualifying analyses; explicitly check corrections, expressions of concern, and retractions.
stop_rules: Complete every planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update query across all three available routes.

Recover and cross-link NCT02092467, protocol A3921133, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, the FDA postmarketing requirement context, the major FDA safety communication, and the corresponding marketed-label action.
Verify that cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have at least one direct pivotal-study source and one search for qualifying or conflicting evidence.
Complete correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, retraction, superseded FDA communication, and registry-change checks through 2024-12-31.
Run two consecutive expansion passes per anchor using linked identifiers, authors, titles, and cited study names; stop when neither pass adds decision-relevant evidence.

Stop observational expansion when additional records cannot change the direction, population boundary, comparator interpretation, dose interpretation, or certainty of any prespecified safety conclusion.
Preserve exact queries, retrieval timestamps, result counts, provider versions when available, identifiers, deduplication decisions, and all query-to-record links before declaring retrieval complete.

If a required route is unavailable or the retrieval budget is exhausted, stop with the affected outcome and source class recorded as a coverage gap rather than treating absence of retrieval as absence of evidence.
